clientFunction.name: get_subscriptions
clientFunction.description: Return the subscription set for a given month — the running monthly total and the individual subscription line items (e.g. Netflix, Spotify, British Gas). Use this when the customer asks about subscriptions, recurring charges, or monthly bills. Pass show=true when the customer asked to SEE the list ("show me my subscriptions", "what are my recurring charges?"): the app navigates to spending and surfaces the subscriptions-audit view. Returns { month_label, monthly_total, items:[{vendor,amount}] }.

month.description: Optional. 0 = current month (default), 1 = last month, 2 = two months ago.

show.description: Optional. When true, the app also navigates to the spending page and surfaces the subscriptions-audit view. Use when the customer asked to SEE the list; omit (or false) for pure data lookups like 'what am I paying for monthly?'.
